description.en: Sets the minimap image shown for the current map, by name.
Name of the minimap image to display.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Swap the minimap image (e.g. for a seasonal variant)
CMND_SET_MINIMAP_IMAGE("mr01b02_sakura");
